mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article (title, summary, content, category, cover_url, view_count, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{category}, #{coverUrl}, #{viewCount}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
